name: MASK1: the fork irreversibility gate with a smaller or no hand mask, offline
registered: 2026-10-26 14:39 EDT, before any MASK1 statistic is computed
motivation: GATE2 stopped (4x / value-OR gates flag the grasp). Topple anatomy (exploratory, h2h4): lfci000's remaining topples are mostly approach / re-approach knocks with the gripper open; the gate fired before only 13 of 36. The current mask ignores patches within 32 px of the hand's planned path plus a 42 px corridor above it, which may cover the neighbours during the approach. Because the reverse branch returns the hand to the current target (gripper commands reversed too), the hand largely cancels between the reverse and hold branches by construction, so a smaller or no mask may work. User 2026-10-26: include no mask.
statistic: CF2 / CF3's reversal residual at 2x, max over 64 draws, flagged iff > 1.3356; per decision ONE imagined rollout scored with four masks: m32 (radius 32 + corridor 42, current), m16 (16 + 21), fing (16, no corridor), none (all patches)
stage_dev: held-out m3 decisions (CF2's selection, draws and seeds). Grades: recall of pre-topple decisions (1-3 chunks ahead), share of safe gripper-closed / safe gripper-open decisions flagged; AUC and 50%-recall flags reported. Eligible: safe_closed <= 5% AND safe_open <= 15%. Selected: the eligible mask with the highest recall, ties within 2 pp -> fewer assumptions (none > fing > m16 > m32). GO_recall iff selected != m32 and its recall >= m32 recall + 10 pp. GO_simplify_none iff none is eligible and its recall >= m32 recall - 3 pp. Neither -> stop and report. eval/mask1.py dev -> mask1_dev.json.
stage_conf: only if a GO: CF3's fresh s4 + h2h2 decisions, same draws. PASS_recall iff GO_recall and the selected mask meets the limits and recall >= m32 + 10 pp there; PASS_simplify_none iff GO_simplify_none and none meets the limits and recall >= m32 - 3 pp there. eval/mask1.py conf -> mask1_conf.json.
next_if_pass: closed-loop dev arm (lfci000 with the passing mask; with none if both pass and none's recall is within 2 pp), episodes 15000-15099, separately registered; then a fresh-episode head-to-head on new episodes.
scope: label-free, task-agnostic; no mask = no camera calibration or hand projection needed; off-the-shelf DINOv2 latent model_OIL.
